_readme: FALLBACK COPY ONLY. The live board records belong in the separate IsatouB/board-data repository, which the widget reads first; this file is what it falls back to while that repo does not exist yet, so it only holds examples. Once board-data is published, leave this file alone — the person keeping the records publishes to that repo from inside the widget (Settings > Publish). Every entry below is marked "example": true so the widget can clear them in one tap.

meetings.title: Example: Quarterly board meeting
meetings.notes: This meeting is an example so you can see how the agenda works. Edit it or delete it.

agenda.title: Minutes of the last meeting
agenda.notes: Circulate the draft two days beforehand so nobody reads it cold.

tasks.title: Example: circulate the draft minutes
tasks.notes: Tap an action item to change the owner, the due date or the status.

tasks.title: Example: confirm the venue for the AGM

docs.title: Example: Bylaws
docs.note: Paste the real link and this becomes one tap away
